stakeholder_summary: The test tried to jump to the Economy section using the table‑of‑contents link, but it landed on the wrong page or showed the wrong view. That wrong view made the next screen look different than expected, so the automated check that compares the screen to a reference image failed. Because the page wasn’t in the right state, later steps that wait for certain items to appear couldn’t find them, causing the test to stop with an error. In short, the wrong navigation early on threw off everything that followed, just like taking a turn onto the wrong street and then being unable to locate the destination you were looking for.
